title: Longest Run Without a Repeat
statement:
A turnstile logged the badge number of each of `n` visitors in the order they arrived. Find the longest block of consecutive visitors in which no badge number appears twice.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `n` integers, the badge numbers in order.

## Output
Print the length of the longest block of consecutive entries whose values are all different.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 100000`
- `0 <= a_i <= 10^9`
